responsibility: This implementation module realizes the gm2 generic character I/O dispatcher as two small stacks of procedure variables, one for output and one for input. Read and Write call the currently installed procedures, PushInput/PushOutput and PopInput/PopOutput manage nested redirection with fixed-depth bounds checks, and module initialization seeds the stacks with IO.Read and IO.Write. Its role is to provide overridable default character streams for higher-level text libraries such as StrIO, Debug, and Scan.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the StdIO pair: it realizes the declared Read/Write dispatcher with input/output procedure stacks, push/pop logic, bounds checks, and initialization to IO.Read and IO.Write.
